description: Insufficient grip exposes collision risk; avoidance failure is deliberately retained

criteria.rationale: Scenario objective only; not a regulatory acceptance criterion. Overlap is sampled each 0.01 s tick.
1 mJ floating-point allowance is far below the run energy scale; this checks software accounting, not physical calibration.
A regression expectation, distinct from the failed collision-avoidance objective; never interpreted as safety success.

criteria.description: Emergency braking applied within 2 s of lead-braking event
criteria.rationale: For gap=35 m, initially equal speeds and lead deceleration=6 m/s², TTC=2 s is crossed at tau=(-12+sqrt(564))/6=1.958 s. A 2.0 s model-development budget allows 0.042 s for tick discretization; added delays can violate it. This is not an ECU or regulatory latency limit.
